svg.title: Benchmark design decides whether attention is faithful
svg.desc: Four rows, one per benchmark design, show the average attention of a trained CNN-BiLSTM-attention model along held-out sequences, aligned on PUM2's UGUANAUA motif. In design D attention concentrates on the motif (hit rate 0.955); in design A it is diffuse (0.398), while AUC runs the other way, 0.695 in D and 0.803 in A. Above, one held-out RNA sequence with its attention.
